Network
Detection & Response (NDR)
AI-driven NDR empowers your team to detect, investigate, and stop threats faster across both IT and OT environments — without adding headcount. By leveraging existing tools and data, it accelerates response, reduces dwell time, and strengthens resilience against lateral movement and advanced attacks.
Download Buyers Guide
Gartner NDR Market Guide
Your browser does not support the video tag.
The Case for
Network Detection
and
Response
While attackers love to target endpoints, their second favorite entry point into your environment is vulnerabilities and weak points on your network. Whether it’s an open port, unpatched vulnerabilities, or a weak website, attackers that gain access to your network can carry out massive distributed attacks that can bring your company to a grinding halt. Previously, you needed networking experts using complex tools to detect threats as they moved across your network. Not anymore. Stellar Cyber NDR is the most comprehensive, easiest-to-use NDR, enabling you to identify, investigate, and eliminate attacks faster than ever.
Download the Infographic
Stellar Cyber
NDR Components
Sensors
Our physical and virtual sensors package together Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), Machine Learning Intrusion Detection System (ML-IDS), and a malware sandbox for zero-day malware analysis.
Learn More About Sensors
Integrations
NDR works smoothly with your existing
next-gen firewalls so you can leverage what you
already have, while using the sensors to
ﬁll coverage gaps.
Learn More About Integrations
Data Lake
Aggregate and store data in a central Data Lake to correlate threats across all your data sources. The Data Lake scales as you grow, so you always have full coverage.
Learn More About Data Lake
Threat Intelligence
Automatically normalize and enrich data with multiple built-in threat intelligence feeds. You can also add your own threat feeds.
Learn More About Threat Intelligence
AI Engine
Stellar Cyber includes AI-powered detections and correlations for NDR and UEBA so that you can detect threats fast.
Learn More About AI Engine
Automated Response
Take response action automatically or manually with one click. Block trafﬁc, contain hosts, disable users, and more.
Learn More About Automated Response
